Login here 0 Cart Your cart is empty Shop our products Electric Guitars Acoustic Guitars Amplifiers Effects & Pedals Accessories Contact Us Home All products ThorpyFX Kudu Roll over image to zoom in Click on image to zoom / ThorpyFX Kudu Save $-299.00 ThorpyFX Price: Sale price $299.00 / Quantity: Sold out     Share this product Description KUDU is an overdrive that has a funny little story behind it. Dan Coggins, who you’ll know of Lovetone fame, designs pedals for ThorpyFx, but musical instruments and their associated gear remains to this day as a hobby for Thorpy. Well, knowing this, on Christmas 2024 Dan gifted me a modified pedal, which as always, sparks an idea for a new product. So, we took inspiration for this modified classic and created a pedal optimised for stacking with other pedals and amps. Why is it called KUDU? Well, there is a variant of the KUDU called the Greater Kudu and as the pedal makes everything sound better... it seemed apt. CONTROL: FOOTSWITCH: ON/OFF True bypass LEVEL: Use this control to balance the output of the pedal. We’ve packed in plenty of volume to this pedal so you can cut and boost your signal using the level. BITE: This control allows you to feed in the correct amount of sizzle and sparkle to your tone. It allows you to tailor the frequencies that interact with your other pedals and amps. Lower settings are smoother, whilst higher settings are more cutting. DRIVE: This control adds or cuts the level of drive on tap. This control is very interactive with the bite control. CLIP: Use this to change between Soft, Hard and Extra Soft clipping, allowing to change the character of your KUDU and the way the harmonics meld with other drive stages. PLACEMENT: KUDU is designed and optimised for stacking, and this is a very personal thing. Our advice is to just have a play with placement and see where it fits your signal chain best. It’s not particularly fussy on placement but it will yield its best results when placed where you want it to be. POWER: The KUDU is designed to be powered by a 9V DC centre-negative 2.1mm power supply. Do not attempt to use this pedal with other voltages or polarities. We have power protection circuitry in our pedals and use of any other voltages will shut the pedal down and may require return to ThorpyFx HQ for repair. This will not be covered under warranty. The ThorpyFX KUDU was born from a modified classic gifted to Thorpy by legendary pedal designer Dan Coggins (of Lovetone fame) on Christmas 2024. Inspired by that circuit, the KUDU was meticulously developed from the ground up with one primary goal: to be the ultimate overdrive for stacking with other pedals and amplifiers. Why "KUDU"? Just like the Greater Kudu species stands out in the wild, this pedal is designed to make everything in your signal chain sound greater. Optimized for Stacking The KUDU isn't fussy about where you place it. Whether you are pushing a British tube amp into saturation or cascading it into another fuzz or distortion pedal, the KUDU melds its harmonics perfectly with your existing gear to yield inspiring, larger-than-life tones. Intuitive Tone Shaping Controls Dial in your perfect drive with four highly interactive controls: LEVEL: Features massive volume on tap, allowing you to heavily cut or aggressively boost your signal to push the front end of your amp. BITE: Your key to cutting through the mix. Lower settings offer a smooth, warm drive, while higher settings add sizzle, sparkle, and top-end cut. DRIVE: Adjusts the overall gain. This control is highly interactive with the BITE knob, allowing you to tailor the exact frequencies pushing into your other drive stages. CLIP: A three-way toggle switch selecting between Soft, Hard, and Extra Soft clipping. This drastically changes the character and feel of the overdrive, giving you three distinct flavors of gain.
